definitions.explanation: Acting without thought or direction, as if groping in the dark.

examples.japanese: やみくもに{走|はし}った。
やみくもに{努力|どりょく}しても{結果|けっか}は{出|で}ない。
examples.english: Even if you make efforts blindly, you won't get results.

examples.japanese: やみくもな{挑戦|ちょうせん}よりも、しっかり{準備|じゅんび}してから{始|はじ}めたほうがいい。
examples.english: Rather than a reckless challenge, it's better to prepare thoroughly before starting.

notes:
Can be written in kanji as {闇雲|やみくも} — literally 'dark clouds,' evoking the image of being unable to see. Most commonly used adverbially as やみくもに, but also works as a na-adjective (やみくもな). Always implies a lack of direction or strategy, not just speed or intensity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やみくもに{走|はし}る: to run blindly
- やみくもに{探|さが}す: to search randomly
- やみくもに{突|つ}き{進|すす}む: to charge ahead recklessly
- やみくもな{行動|こうどう}: reckless behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無闇|むやみ}に: recklessly; excessively — very close in meaning but also carries a sense of 'excessively' or 'without good reason'
- {闇雲|やみくも}に: same word in kanji — the kana spelling is more common
- がむしゃらに: frantically; desperately — implies intense single-minded effort rather than lack of direction
- {手当|てあ}たり{次第|しだい}: at random; indiscriminately — focuses on taking things as they come, one after another
